body: Paramjit Singh Soni (Promoter, Executive Director & Vice-Chairman) on the Q2FY25 call (2024-11-08), prompted: "in calendar year '26, you're already looking at a base case of close to 9 to 10 million of sales starting from there" Metric: Mexico revenue CY2026.
